name: update_draft
description:
Update an existing Outlook draft with new content. Replaces the draft's recipients, subject, and body.

Use this tool when the user wants to modify a draft they previously created.
The message_id should come from outlook_create_draft or outlook_list_drafts.

Note: This completely replaces the draft content. Provide all fields, not just the changed ones.

message_id.description: The message ID of the draft to update (from outlook_create_draft)

to.description: Updated list of recipient email addresses (To field)

body.description: Updated plain text body of the email

body_html.description: Optional: HTML body. If provided, email body is set as HTML content type.
